name: GovTribe
description: Search government contracts, awards, and vendors directly from Claude. GovTribe brings U.S. procurement intelligence into your AI workflow — find relevant opportunities across federal, state, and local agencies; analyze vendor competition; explore teaming partners; and track agency spending patterns.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GovTribe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GovTribe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://govtribe.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GovTribe MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GovTribe lists 24 MCP tools, including Documentation, Search_Federal_Contract_Opportunities, Search_Federal_Contract_Awards, Search_Federal_Contract_IDVs, Search_Federal_Contract_Sub_Awards, Search_Federal_Contract_Vehicles, Search_Federal_Grant_Opportunities, Search_Federal_Grant_Awards, Search_Federal_Grant_Sub_Awards, Search_Federal_Grant_Programs, Search_Federal_Forecasts, and Search_Federal_Transactions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GovTribe?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GovTribe in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
GovTribe requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GovTribe is developed by Government Executive Media Group LLC. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
